lines.text: Marked. Walk out of the Core slowly and I'll pretend I didn't see the colour of your name.
Reyes sent you. Tell Reyes the Row stays his exactly as long as it stays quiet.
Marshal. You're in the Core; that's the good news. Don't make me give you the other kind.
Eight spawns cleared. First deployment below the old limit, by my account. Route for the next patrol still needs an answer.
One page. My record for whoever replaces me. Undercity appears twice among the places left out. Don't add an explanation I didn't write.
Three gates compared. One log records an inside release at oh-four-twelve. No author. Noted; no name goes in that blank on a guess.
Five nesting drones, Block Four. Order assigns a Wake to the approach. Job done. Patrol coverage is a different entry.
Wake. Your lease and your grade are on the record. The Core has protection; past the ring road, check the street.
Expedition filed. Routes, losses, decisions. Keep all three in the record.
Marshal. You're in the Core; that's the good news. Don't make me give you the other kind.

barks.text: Curfew drills at oh-four-hundred. Same time every year. Same reason nobody asks about.
